title: Root and tuber storage guide
context: Smallholder farmers lose produce to poor root and tuber storage; plain-language open guidance reduces loss.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to root and tuber storage summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers root and tuber storage as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no chemical dosing or farm-specific prescriptions
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources (e.g. FAO) with links
